title: Obligation roots: the record, its leaf object and tree, its decoding, leaf availability, the delivery check reading its leaves, and the forced path for elections that commit roots
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/delivery-root-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/delivery.md in Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto or any @noble library. It reuses delivery-batch-vectors.py's records and delivery-vectors.py's ballots, P-256 ECDSA (checked against RFC 6979 Appendix A.2.5 first), postings and complaints; board-vectors.py's RFC 9162 tree (checked against transparency-dev first); and delivery-obligation-vectors.py's intervals and sweep. Its CIDs come from its own dag-pb writer, checked against every CID of content-addressing.json first. Secrets are SHA-256 of fixed labels: test data only.
